info.name: Clinic Booking API reviewer journey
info.description:
Built from contracts/openapi.json (API version 1.0.0) by scripts/api_collection.mjs; edit that script, not this file.

Pick the `local` or `production` environment and run the folders in order. IDs and times flow from one request to the next through collection variables, and every time is computed from now, so the run never goes stale.

Requests other than GET run only when the environment sets `allowWrites` to `true` (local does, production does not).

Public operations not in the journey:
- `POST /realtime/token/patient`: the booking site's live-updates token: it answers only the site's own Origin and needs an Ably key, which the compose stack does not have.

item.name: 03 Slots
item.description: Free 30-minute slots for the doctor on a clinic-local day. The pre-request script starts at tomorrow and the test moves a day ahead (up to 14 times) until the day has at least two free slots, so the run never depends on a fixed date.

item.name: 08 Change within the hour
item.description: Cancelling or rescheduling a visit that starts in under 60 minutes is 409 CHANGE_TOO_LATE. The API never books a slot that close, so this needs an appointment made another way: `make api-check` writes one straight into the local database and passes its id as `soonAppointmentId`. In Postman or Insomnia, paste the id that `make api-check` prints into the environment. Without it these requests are skipped.
